findings.label: SKUs with no supplier lead time
findings.why_it_matters: Lead time sets the protection window every purchase recommendation is sized against. Without it these SKUs fall back to a 14-day assumption, which is wrong for anything imported.
findings.how_to_fix: Set `lead_time_days` per SKU (or per supplier) in your product master.

findings.label: SKUs with no unit cost
findings.why_it_matters: Every rupee figure — working capital, carrying cost, ROI — is zero for these SKUs. They appear free to hold.
